items.name: Year-end 2025 cloud backlog growth
items.claim: NICE's year-end '25 cloud backlog growth accelerates to 25% year over year.
items.source_excerpt: Year-end ’25 cloud backlog growth accelerates to 25% year over year

notes: Q4/FY2025 results press release discloses cloud-backlog growth (not a dollar backlog figure). NICE also carries a structured RPO fact ($3.675bn, period_end 2025-12-31) in data/market/NICE.json#fundamentals.remaining_performance_obligations, but that field is a nested object and tools/check_pipeline.py's xbrl matcher requires a bare scalar, so it cannot be cited as a source_kind: xbrl item under the current gate shape (see tasks/backlog.md, bucket xbrl-nested-field-mismatch, filed this run); omitted rather than written uncitable.
